FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
&
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014
Application are invited for the post of Project Associate-I for following DST project
Title of project: Utilizing the versatile platform of biomass derived nanocellulose
based magnetic nanocomposites for the facilitative removal of organic
pollutants from wastewater Strategy for upscaling
Positions: Project Associate-I (01)
Qualification: The candidates who have passed M.Sc. Chemistry/Physics with minimum
55% marks are eligible to apply. The Candidate should be NET/GATE
Qualified.
Stipend As per DST norms
Applications giving full bio-data along with Xerox copies of the mark sheets and certificates
should reach on or before 10-11-2023 to Prof. Sonal Singhal, Department of Chemistry, Panjab
University, Chandigarh – 160 014. Application can also be forwarded as an e-mail attachment to
sonal@pu.ac.in.
Please note that no TA/DA will be given to the candidates called for the interview.
Principle Investigator
Prof. Sonal Singhal
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Email Id: sonal@pu.ac.in
